entities.name: B8FEU3 uL10
observations: Exact 173-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt B8FEU3 from Desulfatibacillum aliphaticivorans; 100% identity and coverage, E-value 1.53e-117.
Large ribosomal subunit protein uL10, a structural component of the 50S ribosomal stalk; its N-terminus associates with L11 and large-subunit rRNA, while its C-terminal spine binds L12 dimers.
Pfam hits: Ribosomal_L10 (PF00466) at residues 1–99 and RL10_C (PF27436) at residues 127–173.
Sequence-derived estimates: 173 aa, 18.82 kDa, pI 8.37, instability index 27.54, GRAVY −0.056; no explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.
